title: Enable guarded ingest stage dispatcher
summary: Enable the smallest mutation-capable stage dispatcher slice by allowing only the ingest stage to copy a source into a guarded scratch-root child path, with strict execute confirmation, command-journal evidence, source-hash preservation proof, rollback/recovery evidence, and generated contract updates.
reason: The mutation-capable Python/PowerShell stage boundary was modeled but disabled. Ingest is the least destructive candidate because it reads source media and writes only a scratch copy, while transcode, subtitle, audio, publish, drain, and rename remain disabled.
behavior_before: The stage registry modeled ingest as mutation-capable but disabled; its payload used a copy_to_scratch intent exception, and ops/pipeline/engine/entrypoint.ps1 returned stage.not_enabled for every mutation-capable stage.
behavior_after: Only ingest is enabled among mutation-capable stages. Execute requests require intent=execute and confirm_ingest=true as a JSON boolean. Dry-run writes nothing. Execute copies to a non-overwriting scratch-root child path, rejects source-inside-scratch and target-boundary violations, hashes source and scratch, writes an ingest evidence JSON with rollback/recovery actions, and leaves source media read-only.
